commands.expected: intact and restored pass; each fault applies exactly once and fails an acceptance assertion

inputs.vector: job=0, authority=1, premise=1; job advances at intent
inputs.consumer: durable local journal; no arbitrary external callback or exactly-once network claim

probes.atomic: two independent processes race on same database: single intent and single claim; stale vector/epoch/authority/fence, suppression and duplicate intent refuse without partial write
probes.locking: sorted multi-reservation acquisition is atomic; contention rolls back newly acquired reservations only, preserving retained owners
probes.crash: SIGKILL before/after intent, after claim, after consumer acceptance and after readback; reopen same database, keep unknown ownership and deduplicate persisted receipt
probes.delayed: original sender delayed across authority expiry/revocation and attempted reassignment; no duplicate consumer effect, unknown reservation retained
probes.receipt: confirm only exact persisted correlated receipt under current reservation owner/fence; forged/mismatched receipts refuse
probes.migration: old methods compatible on unadopted lanes; every legacy mutation/dispatch/reconciliation bypass on adopted lane refused; no automatic rollback; same database consumer proof

evidence_schema.candidate_pin: final evidence-only commit is named in single Issue result comment; source revision is committed before retained run
evidence_schema.measurements: unmeasured token/cost/provider use null with reason

boundaries: preserve S0 success-collapse and platform limitations and S1 evidence
no sibling work, live adoption, service/profile mutation, deployment, RAI, pending amendments or other repository changes
disposition: runtime-managed candidate retained for independent VERIFY and subsequent authorized closure; no main push
